I'm faction 1, not president. Round 5 action. Next market round 6: I have 0 goods. Produce gives 2 goods, sellable in round 6 at decent price. Cash counts at end; goods don't. Need cash for final rank — but selling converts goods to cash, good. Produce: 2 goods → sell ~10 each = 20 alashi. Influence matters for max influence bonus (5% of bank = ~3 alashi + presidency). Currently all influence 1, my vote_weight 3 (passed action previously? no, weight = influence+2 if action passed... weight 3 because last round action? whatever). Bribe 5M gives influence 2 — could win max influence bonus? Others might bribe too. Influence stays in round 6? Influence persists. Bribe 5M to gain influence 2, likely securing presidency and 5% commission + veto. But presidency requires most influence; bribe cost 5 vs bonus ~3.15. Also as president in law round 5 and 6 can veto bad laws (tax). Tax 20% on round 6 sales of ~20 alashi = 4 alashi — veto valuable.

Produce gives 2 goods worth ~20 alashi in round 6 market. That's the biggest. Combine? Only one action. Choose produce (choice 1). Actually influence also gives vote weight in law. But 20 alashi produce > bribe benefits. Choose 1.
